hero.title: Your website.

how.title: Online in three steps
how.subtitle: Registration happens only in chat – not on this website.
how.step1Text: Message the agent on WhatsApp or Telegram. We check your phone number or Telegram ID.
how.step2Text: Trade, location, services, hours. In your own words – German or English.
how.step3Text: One business, one website. Later changes go through the same chat.

audience.title: Built for local businesses
audience.subtitle: No agency. No website-builder course. A clear introduction page.
audience.bakeriesText: Menu, hours, address – updated from your phone.
audience.tradesText: Services and enquiries without maintaining a site yourself.
audience.practicesText: A professional presence with contact details for clients.
audience.shopsText: A page people can find – and you can change by message.

cta.title: Create your website now

datenschutz.title: Privacy policy
datenschutz.intro: GDPR placeholder. Replace with a reviewed version before going live.
datenschutz.dataText: When you message us on WhatsApp or Telegram we store your mobile number or Telegram ID, message content needed for the website, and the mapping to exactly one website. Purpose: account creation, running your introduction site, support.
datenschutz.legalText: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract / pre-contract) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure operation).
datenschutz.retentionText: Data is kept while your account exists, then according to statutory retention rules.
datenschutz.rightsText: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection. You may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in Berlin: Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit.
datenschutz.messagingText: Messages go through Meta (WhatsApp) or Telegram. Their privacy notices also apply. Only message us if you agree to this processing.
